name: Color by Group
description: Paints the active piece from its face groups: one group in a color you pick, or every group in its own color. Masked vertices keep their color. Shows the result before you accept it.

params.label: Group
params.help: Which face group gets the chosen color. 0 is the usual ungrouped faces. In Every group, the others get their own colors.

params.text: Masked vertices keep their color. A vertex on a border blends the groups that meet there.
